title.zh: 只改一个地方的小练习
title.en: A small exercise with one change

paragraphs.zh: 复盘可沿用邀请卡：先保留对称细框，把颜色从金黑换成铅笔灰，再单独改成偏心边框。每轮只换一项，说清此刻更想留下哪处。可只在脑中比较，不制作成品。这帮助区分颜色和布局的吸引力，不证明年代归属、奢华偏好或设计能力；两版都喜欢也有用。
paragraphs.en: Review the invitation by keeping a symmetrical fine frame while changing gold-black to pencil grey, then changing only the frame to an off-centre one. Compare one change at a time and name the detail you want now. Imagine without making. This separates colour and layout without establishing an era identity, luxury preference or design ability; liking both is useful too.

title.zh: 完整阅读与这份题本的边界
title.en: Full reading and the bank’s boundaries

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果邀请卡拿掉金色后仍好看，你最想保留哪一道线，又愿意改哪一处对称关系？”各说一个视觉理由，再互换其中一项元素。对方可只看、换题、不回答或结束；不用上传作品、公开照片、花钱或互相评分。公开链接只带通用说明，不含个人答案或计数；不从年代标签推断人格、伦理、收入、职业或关系适配。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If an invitation still appealed without gold, which line would you retain and which symmetry would you change?” Give one visual reason each, then swap a single element. The other person may observe, change topics, decline or stop, without uploads, private photos, spending or ratings. Public links open general readings without answers or counts. Infer no personality, ethics, income, career or compatibility from era labels.

title.zh: 选一个重复单元，留一点变化
title.en: Try one repeated unit with a little variation

paragraphs.zh: 复盘可沿用叶形边框：把同一片自编叶子重复六次，第二版只转动其中两片，再让标题位置不变。若整齐版也喜欢，不必为了“手作感”改答案。可只想象，不借用不熟悉的传统图案。比较的是重复与变化，不评真诚、环保、文化身份或谁更自然。
paragraphs.en: Review the leaf border by repeating one invented leaf six times and turning only two in another version, with the title fixed. A regular version may appeal without requiring an answer changed to preserve a handmade label. Imagine without borrowing unfamiliar traditional motifs. Compare repetition and variation without grading sincerity, environmental responsibility, cultural identity or naturalness.

title.zh: 保留喜欢的细节，其他部分可以放下
title.en: Keep the detail you like and leave the rest

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果同一叶形重复六次，你想把哪两片转向，还是更喜欢完全整齐的版本？为什么？”各说一个视觉理由，再互换其中一项元素。对方可只看、换题、不回答或结束；不用上传作品、公开照片、花钱或互相评分。公开链接只带通用说明，不含个人答案或计数；不从年代标签推断人格、伦理、收入、职业或关系适配。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “With one leaf repeated six times, which two would you turn, or would you prefer them all aligned, and why?” Give one visual reason each, then swap a single element. The other person may observe, change topics, decline or stop, without uploads, private photos, spending or ratings. Public links open general readings without answers or counts. Infer no personality, ethics, income, career or compatibility from era labels.

title.zh: 让同一条弧线有两种节奏
title.en: Give one curve two different rhythms

paragraphs.zh: 复盘可沿用点状圆弧：一版只让点距渐远，另一版只让点变小，曲线和颜色保持相同。看更喜欢哪种延伸感，或把两者都放下。可只用笔，不做灯具和反光物。这里比较静态纸面的疏密，不测舞蹈、外向、身体活力或是否喜欢聚会，也不要求别人用热情回应。
paragraphs.en: Review the dotted arc with widening spacing in one version and shrinking dots in another, holding curve and colour fixed. Compare the sense of extension or decline both. Use a pencil without lamps or reflective objects. This concerns spacing on a still page, not dancing, extraversion, physical energy or party interest, and needs no enthusiastic response from someone else.

title.en: You can finish with the full reading

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果圆弧上的点只改大小或只改间距，你更想看哪一种变化，又想留多少空白？”各说一个视觉理由，再互换其中一项元素。对方可只看、换题、不回答或结束；不用上传作品、公开照片、花钱或互相评分。公开链接只带通用说明，不含个人答案或计数；不从年代标签推断人格、伦理、收入、职业或关系适配。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If arc dots changed only size or only spacing, which variation would you prefer and how much empty space would you leave?” Give one visual reason each, then swap a single element. The other person may observe, change topics, decline or stop, without uploads, private photos, spending or ratings. Public links open general readings without answers or counts. Infer no personality, ethics, income, career or compatibility from era labels.

title.zh: 把斜线拿走一次，再放回来
title.en: Remove the diagonal once, then restore it

paragraphs.zh: 复盘可沿用双色标题卡：先把标题完整放好，再只比较有斜线和无斜线两版。若拿掉斜线仍喜欢，下一轮可单独换颜色，不一次重做全部。可以只画小草图。比较的是这段文字与色面怎样配合，不评气势、竞争、权力欲或职业能力，也不要求选最像商业海报的一版。
paragraphs.en: Review the two-colour title card by placing the words first, then comparing a version with a diagonal and one without. If both appeal, change colour separately next rather than rebuilding everything. Sketch small only. Compare words and panels without grading forcefulness, competition, power-seeking or professional ability, or choosing the most commercial-looking poster.

title.zh: 保留一个构图想法就够了
title.en: One composition idea is enough to keep

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果同一标题卡只多一条斜线，你更喜欢方向感还是稳定感？换颜色后会不会不同？”各说一个视觉理由，再互换其中一项元素。对方可只看、换题、不回答或结束；不用上传作品、公开照片、花钱或互相评分。公开链接只带通用说明，不含个人答案或计数；不从年代标签推断人格、伦理、收入、职业或关系适配。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If one title card added only a diagonal, would you prefer direction or stability, and might a colour change alter that?” Give one visual reason each, then swap a single element. The other person may observe, change topics, decline or stop, without uploads, private photos, spending or ratings. Public links open general readings without answers or counts. Infer no personality, ethics, income, career or compatibility from era labels.

paragraphs.zh: 复盘可沿用格纹底纸：先保持上层边缘齐整，只改变露出底层的面积；再固定面积，单独改一条不齐边。这样可以看吸引你的是覆盖还是粗糙。只画纸片即可，不撕书、不弄旧衣物。发现喜欢干净边缘不推翻结果，偏好也不证明消费态度、收入、真实性或整理习惯。
paragraphs.en: Review the checked underlayer by keeping a straight upper edge while varying the exposed area, then fixing that area and changing one edge. This separates overlap from roughness. Draw scraps without tearing books or distressing clothes. Liking clean edges need not invalidate the reading, and preferences establish no consumption attitude, income, authenticity or tidiness.

title.zh: 把一小块喜欢的纹理留下
title.en: Keep one small texture you like

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果只调整格纹露出的面积、不增加粗糙感，你会留下多少底层，又想让标题停在哪里？”各说一个视觉理由，再互换其中一项元素。对方可只看、换题、不回答或结束；不用上传作品、公开照片、花钱或互相评分。公开链接只带通用说明，不含个人答案或计数；不从年代标签推断人格、伦理、收入、职业或关系适配。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If only the visible check area changed without added roughness, how much would you retain and where would the title sit?” Give one visual reason each, then swap a single element. The other person may observe, change topics, decline or stop, without uploads, private photos, spending or ratings. Public links open general readings without answers or counts. Infer no personality, ethics, income, career or compatibility from era labels.

title.zh: 把透明感拿走，看还喜欢什么
title.en: Remove the translucent effect and see what remains

paragraphs.zh: 复盘可沿用圆角小窗：第一轮只比较平色和重叠变深的效果，第二轮才添加一个自编像素符号。若只喜欢圆角，可把亮边和像素都去掉。可以只想象，不复制软件界面、商标或购买旧设备。这是在拆开轮廓与层次，不测技术、怀旧、年龄或世代身份，也不要求生活变成整套Y2K。
paragraphs.en: Review the rounded window by comparing flat colour with a darker overlap first, then adding one invented pixel mark. Keep only rounded corners if rims and pixels do not appeal. Imagine without copying interfaces or logos or buying old devices. Separate outline and layering without assessing technology, nostalgia, age or generational identity, or requiring an entire Y2K lifestyle.

title.zh: 完整结果不要求证明经历或消费
title.en: Full results require no proof of experience or purchases

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果圆角小窗去掉亮边与像素，你还想保留什么？透明叠色会不会改变你的选择？”各说一个视觉理由，再互换其中一项元素。对方可只看、换题、不回答或结束；不用上传作品、公开照片、花钱或互相评分。公开链接只带通用说明，不含个人答案或计数；不从年代标签推断人格、伦理、收入、职业或关系适配。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a rounded window lost its rim and pixels, what would you retain, and would translucent layering change the choice?” Give one visual reason each, then swap a single element. The other person may observe, change topics, decline or stop, without uploads, private photos, spending or ratings. Public links open general readings without answers or counts. Infer no personality, ethics, income, career or compatibility from era labels.
